_description: Cluster impressions keyed by sorted family names (frozenset signature). If a cluster's parent_family set matches a key here, use the pre-written impression. Otherwise, auto-generate from top-3 flavor dimensions.

rich_complex.impression: Rich & complex spirits · Shared notes of vanilla, wood and body. These spirits bridge aged whiskey and fortified wines — all shine in stirred cocktails where depth is the point.

bitter_italians.impression: Bitter italians · Dominant amaro and spice, anchored by citrus. The backbone of aperitivo culture — from Campari to Angostura, these define the Italian aperitivo hour.

aromatic_floral.impression: Aromatic & floral spirits · Light-bodied, citrus-forward, herbal. Gin is the core, but Select and Martini Ambrato share enough botanical character to cluster alongside.

alpine_amaro.impression: Alpine & artichoke bitterness · Both reach deep into bitter-herbal territory — Braulio via mountain herbs, Cynar via artichoke. Interchangeable in some cocktail contexts.

resinous_botanicals.impression: Resinous botanicals · Koval's forest gin and Chandolia's Chios mastic share a rare quality: they taste like somewhere specific. Both are resinous, herb-heavy, with a mentholated edge.

delicate_umami.impression: Delicate umami · Low intensity, subtle fruit, distinctive umami. Japanese sake occupies its own quiet corner — nothing else in the collection competes for this space.
